messages:
anna_ml: Quick triage - while running the FP8 AWQ/GPTQ bakeoff on H100 (CUDA 13.2, Triton 2.2, TensorRT-LLM 1.4) we're hitting cublasLt errors and kernel failures.

anna_ml: Repro steps attached, failing consistently on single-stream inference. Not an OOM but kernel exec fails.

ramon: Can you paste the exact error snippet and the model/config used?

anna_ml: logs:
```
E cublasLt: CUBLAS_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED when calling cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/redwood/runtime/serve.py", line 412, in infer_batch
    out = driver.kernel_launch(... )
RuntimeError: CUDA error: CUBLAS_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED
```

kevin_infra: This smells like a kernel selection mismatch between CUDA 13.x + TRT-LLM FP8 kernels on H100. We didn't see it on A100. vLLM path often avoids some custom cuBLASLt kernels but is slower.

maya_qc: For reference, in our QA runs AWQ-FP8 showed an avg MMLU delta of -1.8% vs FP16 baseline on this model (small-v2); GPTQ-4bit was -0.9%. Throughput: Triton+AWQ-FP8 ~24 req/s, vLLM fallback ~14 req/s for same instance type (single threaded). Latency single-query: 42ms -> 75ms when falling back.

anna_ml: Repro command I used:
```
python -m bakeoff.run --model small-v2 --quant awq-fp8 --driver tensorrt-llm --batch 1 --seq 512 --device h100-rt1
```

ramon: Could you check container cuBLASLt version and kernel list? Also try forcing `LD_PRELOAD` for the nvidia libs or run with `--driver vllm` to confirm fallback works.

build-bot: CI: build/quant-bake-18321 integrated tests passed on linux-x86 but failed on h100-rt1 integration (log: https://ci.redwood/18321).

kevin_infra: Short-term mitigation: add a routing rule in smart-router: if driver==13.* and quant==awq-fp8 -> route to gptq-4bit variant or to dedicated A100 pool. I'll open INF-4027. Longer-term: driver/kernel blacklist in the runtime.

maya_qc: @anna_ml please push the eval diffs and full artifact (eval.json, prompts, references) to the ticket. We need MMLU/Winogrande/QA breakdown and per-batch seed runs.

anna_ml: Ticket created: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4027 - added logs, nvidia-smi output, and the bakeoff command. Assigning @ramon and @kevin_infra. :eyes:

ramon: Action items for triage:
- capture `nvidia-smi -q` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`
- record Triton / cuBLASLt / libcudart versions
- re-run with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to get deterministic failure
- try `--batch 8` and `--kv-cache-disable` to check memory vs kernel select

maya_qc: I'll add a fail-fast check in the harness to auto-try vLLM when we hit cublasLt errors and to record latency/accuracy tradeoffs.

kevin_infra: I'll put a temporary routing flag on prod (ttl 24h) so customers on hosted API won't hit failing path. We can update routing policy to prefer gptq-4bit for h100+cuda13 until root cause fixed.

anna_ml: Thanks all — I'll attach the full stacktrace and run the `LD_PRELOAD` experiment now, will report back with `nvidia-smi` output and container tags.
